code_exercises.title: Bennett Acceptance Ratio (BAR) Self-Consistent Log-Ratio Fermi Residual
code_exercises.prompt_markdown:
Implement `bennett_acceptance_ratio_residual(du_forward, du_reverse, delta_f_trial, kT)` to evaluate the overflow-safe Bennett Acceptance Ratio (BAR) log-ratio residual at trial free energy $\Delta F = \text{delta\_f\_trial}$:
- `du_forward` ($n_0$ samples from state $0$): forward work $\Delta U_{0\to 1}(x) = U_1(x) - U_0(x)$.
- `du_reverse` ($n_1$ samples from state $1$): reverse work $\Delta U_{1\to 0}(x) = U_0(x) - U_1(x)$.
- Define $C = \Delta F + k_B T \ln(n_1 / n_0)$ and Fermi function $f(x) = \frac{1}{1 + e^x}$ (using $\ln f(x) = -\operatorname{logaddexp}(0, x)$ for overflow safety).
- Compute the log-ratio BAR residual:
  $$R(\Delta F) = \ln\!\left(\sum_{i=1}^{n_0} f\!\left(\frac{\Delta U_{0\to 1, i} - C}{k_B T}\right)\right) - \ln\!\left(\sum_{j=1}^{n_1} f\!\left(\frac{\Delta U_{1\to 0, j} + C}{k_B T}\right)\right)$$
  (which equals $\ln\!\left(\frac{\langle f((\Delta U_{0\to 1}-C)/k_B T)\rangle_0}{\langle f((\Delta U_{1\to 0}+C)/k_B T)\rangle_1}\right) - \ln(n_1/n_0)$ and vanishes identically at the exact BAR free energy!).
- **Returns:** finite scalar `float` residual.
